title: Fable III
setupHint: Save your game in Fable III, or select your hero's *_herosave.bin in Settings.
pathPlaceholder: Path to Saved Games\Lionhead Studios\Fable 3\<profile> (or a *_herosave.bin)
autoTag: Unlocks automatically from the game's own achievement record or your hero's statistics
trackingNote: Fable III keeps its own record of the achievements you have earned when it runs through XLiveEmu (Fable 3\XLiveEmu\Player1\Achievements\Achievements.txt in the game folder). The plugin reads that record, and your hero's statistics (Saved Games\Lionhead Studios\Fable 3), so all 60 achievements, Traitor's Keep included, unlock a few seconds after the game awards them.
statSource: NonLeaderboardStats in <hero>_herosave.bin; each stat is keyed by the 32-bit FNV-1 hash of its name. Values checked against a 100% hero (gnomes 50, flowers 30, keys 54) and a new hero (all 0).

xliveSource: Achievement IDs from the game's own achievement tables, matched by name: the XDBF/SPA resource in Fable3.exe (XACH section, English XSTR names) gives The Guild Seal = 69 ... Adopt Or Die = 129, and the Traitor's Keep DLC table (DLC\03_InquisitorsPack\Content\spa.bin, 60 entries) adds A Slow Day At The Office = 130 ... Set Them Free! = 139. XLiveEmu writes one unlocked ID per line.
